weights_used.rationale: Offer framing is 'current buyer' - we want tour operators who already sell Canary Islands holidays and could send clients to TL Travel as their ground handler. Destination_overlap is set high positive (30) since Canary Islands is a specific destination and operators explicitly mentioning it are exactly who TL Travel needs introductions to. Source_markets are low-confidence (inferred from English/German site languages only, no direct evidence), so country is capped at 8 per the rule. ICP is medium-high (17) given TL Travel's strict B2B incoming model primarily serving tour operators. Niche_penalty is moderate-high (13) to filter operators whose niche (polar, safari, ski, wine-only) has zero overlap with a Canary Islands sun-beach DMC.

prospect_summary: TL Travel Incoming Services Canarias is a Gran Canaria-based DMC and incoming travel agency specializing in ground services for the Canary Islands (Gran Canaria, Lanzarote, Fuerteventura, Tenerife) and, since 2025, Tunisia. In operation since 2014, they serve B2B tour operators and travel agencies with airport transfers, accommodation contracting (direct hotel contracts plus a 60,000+ hotel portfolio), car rentals, excursions, and group management. Their reservation platform (Dispongo) integrates with tour operator systems. The site operates in English, Spanish, and German, indicating a European B2B focus. They describe themselves as a local ground-services specialist with a global distribution network.
